Maybe I
Lost my mind
No one noticed
No one noticed

It's getting old (I'd kinda like it if you'd call me)
All alone ('cause I'm so over bein' lonely)
May have lost it (I need a virtual connection)

No one tried
To read my eyes

Maybe I (I'd kinda like it if you'd call me)
